entries.name: SENTRIX
entries.description: A fictional security operations website with an interactive incident console, evidence timelines, keyboard-driven scenarios and responsive editorial composition.
entries.hero: A fictional cybersecurity operations concept that brings incident context, response decisions and interactive timelines into one evidence-led experience.
entries.prompt: Use Web & UI Design v1.5.0 to build a complete responsive website for SENTRIX, a fictional cybersecurity SaaS helping engineering teams investigate threats and coordinate incident response. Define its identity from the security domain rather than applying a generic SaaS template. Deliver a real working HTML/CSS/JS site with a demo incident console, accessible keyboard controls, responsive mobile layout, polished motion and a clear separation between illustrative interactions and real security features. Run actual browser tests and report limitations. Do not invent customers, certifications, integrations or performance metrics.
entries.qa:
The original SENTRIX QA used in-memory Chromium page content because direct URL navigation was blocked by its test container policy; the source's local HTTP assets independently returned 200. This gallery independently checks actual localhost HTTP navigation and responsive interactions.

All incidents are fictional simulations. No production security monitoring, external service, backend or user account is connected.
entries.provenance: This is a manual prototype created using Web & UI Design guidance, not evidence of an automatically invoked official Skill evaluation. Direct live URL tests were not possible in the upstream Chromium container; the gallery retests over localhost.
entries.intro: A security-focused marketing and interface concept featuring real interactive investigation scenarios instead of stock cybersecurity visuals.

features.title: Incident scenario console
features.description: Switch among three illustrative security incidents and inspect the associated context.

features.title: Keyboard-friendly navigation
features.description: Arrow-key scenario tabs, responsive mobile navigation and visible focus states.

features.title: Evidence-based timeline
features.description: Selected incidents update their event sequence, assessment and next action.

features.title: Local response brief
features.description: Add the current example action to a local brief, reset the case or download a concept note.

features.title: Clear security storytelling
features.description: Operational dark canvases, restrained alert colors and editorial sections explain the product idea.

features.title: Motion with restraint
features.description: Animated incident trace and scroll-reveal effects with a reduced-motion fallback.

entries.limitation: Fictional security product and sample events only. No actual detection, incident response, live telemetry, authentication, protected systems or infrastructure integration.

entries.name: LITTLE FERN
entries.description: An illustrated science-learning website for ages 7–11 with interactive plant experiments, category-filtered adventures, complete demo lessons and parent-guided activities.
entries.hero: A fictional playful science-learning experience for ages 7–11—designed to turn curiosity about nature, space and everyday science into little interactive discoveries.
entries.prompt: Use the Web & UI Design skill to build a complete responsive website for LITTLE FERN, a fictional interactive science platform for children ages 7–11 and the grown-ups who learn alongside them. Let the audience shape the typography, illustration, color, layout, copywriting and motion—not a generic SaaS template. Create real exploratory interactions for nature, space and everyday science, complete short lesson flows, a supervised at-home experiment, keyboard-accessible dialogs, and browser-local saved discoveries. Build in HTML, CSS and JavaScript and verify desktop and mobile. Do not request registration or claim real customers, qualifications or learning outcomes. Report actual checks and limitations.
entries.qa:
The source QA records a Chromium browser review of six responsive widths, interactive lessons and dialog focus handling. This gallery separately validates the actual HTTP-served preview and download archive.

Fictional educational concept, not formally reviewed curriculum. Adults should supervise science experiments. No child accounts, analytics or remote service are connected.
entries.provenance: The supplied archive claims Web & UI Design guided creation but the exact installed Skill version was not independently certified. The original checks were browser emulations, not physical child-user testing or a formal accessibility assessment.
entries.intro: A curiosity-first science learning experience with original inline illustrations, practical micro-lessons and carefully guided activity states.

features.title: Interactive plant illustration
features.description: Tap the sunshine control to see a clearly labeled accelerated plant-growth explanation.

features.title: Browse by science topic
features.description: Filter interactive adventures across nature, space and everyday science.

features.title: Complete mini lessons
features.description: Question feedback, retries and a final mission form each of the three sample lessons.

features.title: Save a discovery
features.description: Store sample lesson selections locally in the same browser without creating an account.

features.title: Guided home experiment
features.description: Walking-water instructions follow a five-item checklist and adult-supervision guidance.

features.title: Keyboard-accessible dialogs
features.description: Native dialog semantics, focus loop, Escape close and focus restoration support interaction.

entries.limitation: Fictional activity platform. No school certification, curriculum validation, child user studies, external accounts or backend. Experiments require adult supervision.
